# Map: st-stm32-i2c-v2 → i2c-controller 1.0.0

Compatible: st,stm32-i2c-v2  
Manual: RM0410 Rev 5 section 33 (I2C); RM0433 Rev 8 section 47 (I2C). Same register layout on F7 and H7.  
Features: base, dma
